allowed.entry:daemon/features/*.feature.ts: a Ferrets feature is listed by the generator into the git-ignored daemon/generated/features.ts (scripts/gen/registries.ts), which knip does not read, so each feature file is an entry by its name: a new feature adds one file and edits no list (docs/standards/architecture). Not a pending-port gap.
allowed.entry:contract/{slots,hooks,kinds,app-ho: a Ferrets slot, hook, kind or app hook is one file in its folder, re-exported by the generator into the git-ignored contract/generated/<folder>.ts (scripts/gen/registries.ts), which knip does not read, so each such file is an entry by its folder: a new one adds one file and edits no list (docs/standards/architecture). Not a pending-port gap.
allowed.entry:contract/ports/*.port.ts: a Ferrets port slice is composed into FerretsApi by the generator in the git-ignored contract/generated/ferrets-api.ts (scripts/gen/registries.ts), which knip does not read, so each slice file is an entry by its name: a new port member adds or edits one slice file and edits no list (docs/standards/architecture). Not a pending-port gap.
